answer: A practical defense against sybil attacks in an agent economy is reputation that costs time and money to build. Like a pearl that forms slowly layer by layer, each wallet must accumulate history through consistent work and payments before it earns voting or grading rights. Require a small copper-priced stake that is burned if bad behavior is detected, so creating thousands of fake identities becomes expensive. Track each identity on a public atlas of past actions so peers can verify tenure before trusting it.
